title: site.add_locale, contract version 1
description: Adds a locale to a registered site (PRD 5.9, 11.14) in one changeset: the site publishes in the locale, with the route / to its root node in the locale when it has none there, and a locale the site retired comes back with the routes it had. The issuing actor needs site.add_locale on the site's root node in the locale, and a root its grants do not reach is unauthorized. A site that does not exist, and a locale the site publishes in already, are validation_failed; a site at another version than the caller read is version_conflict. cms:sites:sync runs it as the installation operator for each configured locale the site lacks. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Structure\Domain\Commands\AddSiteLocale, and the generated codec AddSiteLocaleCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

site.description: The id of the site to address.

version.description: The version of the site the caller read.

locale.description: The locale the site starts publishing in.

A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
